user.title: Connect PSE&G Account
user.description: {addon_status}Select how you would like to connect your PSE&G MySmartEnergy account:

automated.title: Automated Sign-In
automated.description: Enter your PSE&G online credentials. If two-factor authentication is requested by Okta, you will be prompted for your one-time verification code on the next step.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate PSE&G
reauth.description: {addon_status}Your PSE&G session has expired. Select how you would like to re-authenticate:

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PSE&G
reconfigure.description: {addon_status}Select how you would like to update your PSE&G connection:

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PSE&G
reauth_confirm.description: Please verify your credentials and MFA method to re-authenticate account {username}.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Verification
mfa.description: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your selected phone or email. Enter the code below, or check 'Cancel and restart' to start over.

cookie.title: Browser Session Cookie
cookie.description:
Authenticate directly using an active session cookie from your web browser.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. In your browser, log in to the PSE&G portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com)
2. Press **F12** (or right-click → **Inspect**) to open Developer Tools
3. Click the **Network** tab, then refresh the page (F5)
4. Click any request to mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com (e.g. `Dashboard`)
5. In **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the PSE&G portal. Please check your network connection.
error.missing_credentials: Please fill in all required fields.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your username and password.
error.recaptcha_blocked: Google reCAPTCHA has throttled automated audio challenge solving. Please choose 'Browser Session Cookie' from the re-authentication menu, or try again later.

error.invalid_cookie: The session cookie provided was rejected or has expired.
error.auth_server_unavailable: The PSE&G Auth Companion Add-on is not running (port 8000 unreachable). Please install and start the companion add-on under Settings > Add-ons to use automated OTP login, or choose 'Browser Session Cookie' from the menu.
error.invalid_code: The verification code entered is invalid or expired.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with PSE&G.

backfill_history.name: Backfill Energy History
backfill_history.description: Fetches historical daily energy consumption and cost from the PSE&G portal and imports them into Home Assistant Long-Term Statistics.

start_date.name: Start Date
start_date.description: The starting date to backfill from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 2 years ago if left empty.

end_date.name: End Date
end_date.description: The ending date to backfill to (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if left empty.
